name: Physical Changes VR
summary:
Explore the fascinating world of physical changes through an interactive educational VR experience designed for fourth-grade students.

Discover how materials can change in shape, size, or state without forming a new substance. Through simple and engaging virtual experiments, students will explore examples of physical changes, such as melting, freezing, cutting, and shaping materials.
